dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
I had the privilege of enjoying Chocolate Elmhurst during a Straycation this past weekend. He is such a playful, loving and affectionate puppy. Chocolate is a great companion! He demonstrates great listening skills during his stay. He is very much a "velcro" dog .. chocolate elmhurst loves to be wherever his human is-whether laying on your feet, sitting nearby while dishes are being washed, or resting next to the dining table during dinner time/resting while I watched movies. Chocolate will benefit from someone who is patient and understanding that he does still have some puppy behaviors; for example: mouthiness (nibbles on hands and feet trying to play), working on crate-training and potty-training (completing all his buisness outside).
dog.name: Chocolate Elmhurst
